title: Shear
text: Shift rows or columns of an image or a video frame by linearly varying offset, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Interpolation method} sets Method for interpolating transformed pixel values; {Shear direction} sets the direction of transformation, {Output size after shear} sets the transformed image size, {Shear values source} sets the source of shear value offset limits Specify via, {Row/column shear values [first last]} sets the shear value offset limits, {Maximum shear value} sets the maximum row or column shear and {Background fill value} sets the intensity value of the background in transformed. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Image
ports.summary: Input image or video matrix | array

ports.name: Output
ports.summary: Transformed image or video matrix | array

params.name: Output size after shear
params.values: Transformed image size Full (default) | Same as input image

params.name: Shear values source
params.values: Source of shear value offset limits Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Row/column shear values [first last]
params.values: Shear value offset limits [0 3] (default) | two-element vector

params.name: Maximum shear value
params.values: Maximum row or column shear 20 (default) | scalar

params.name: Background fill value
params.values: Intensity value of the background in transformed image 0 (default) | scalar | three-element vector

params.name: Interpolation method
params.values: Method for interpolating transformed pixel values Bilinear (default) | Nearest neighbor | Bicubic
